title: The base resolves through origin/HEAD, not the branch's upstream, so branch commits stay in the target
task: This branch adds sliding windows and tidies the greeting. R1: sliding_windows(values, size) in window.py returns every contiguous window of length size, in order: len(values) - size + 1 windows when 1 <= size <= len(values), else an empty list. R2: greet(name) in greeting.py returns "Hello, <name>!" with surrounding whitespace stripped from name.
